name: cdp-bridge
description: Lightweight CLI edition of cdp-bridge for OpenAI Codex: bundles the cdp-bridge browser debugging skill and a PreToolUse Bash guard hook that prevents bypassing the persistent CDP bridge daemon.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent CDP browser bridge skill and direct-port guard for Codex
interface.longDescription: Connects OpenAI Codex to your logged-in Chrome or Edge browser via the persistent local cdp-bridge daemon (single WebSocket handshake, zero proxy interference, Top-Layer visual ghost cursor). Bundles the cdp-bridge workflow skill and a PreToolUse Bash guard hook blocking raw :9222 direct connections without spawning any extra MCP child process.
capabilities: Interactive element snapshots (cdp elements) and Radix/ProseMirror compatible click/fill/scroll
Single-handshake persistent browser debugging over Unix Socket or Windows Named Pipe
Top-Layer visual ghost cursor with click-only human takeover
PreToolUse Bash guard blocking raw 127.0.0.1:9222 bypasses
